blurb: Guests explore aquatic animals including sharks, hippos, sea turtles, penguins, and octopus. Features include the world's longest v-shaped Shark Bridge, New Jersey's longest Shark Tunnel, 3D Theater, and interactive exhibits. Offers animal encounters, live shows, scheduled feedings, and seasonal festivals.
